summary: US stocks rebounded Monday as the Nasdaq rose 1.1% and the S&P 500 0.4% (7,691), helped by a 1.6% rise in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index that ended an eight-session losing run; the Kospi gained 1.8% as institutions bought after seven straight losses. The 10-year US yield edged up to about 5.14% ahead of the Fed's Oct 27-28 meeting, and the VIX eased to 18.4. Oil is the live risk: WTI settled near 103.66 Monday and rose about 5% more on Tuesday after Iran said mines had halted two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, a claim not independently confirmed. WMO outlooks point to a strong El Nino, with drought concern across Southeast Asia, a failed northern rainy season in the Horn of Africa and a below-normal Indian monsoon, while EU gas storage was reported at 73% full, the lowest for the date since 2011. Coverage this run is thinner than usual: many commodity, shipping and impact-group prices and all reading feeds could not be retrieved (see gaps).

headlines.story: Iran says mines halted two tankers in Hormuz; oil jumps
headlines.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said naval mines set two loaded tankers ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz, a claim without independent confirmation, and WTI rose 2.2% on Monday and about 5.7% on Tuesday.

coverage.title: Two Oil Tankers Hit Mines While Crossing Strait of Hormuz
Iran says mines halted two tankers in Hormuz, as US oil price soars over 5% on conflict

headlines.framing: Reuters stresses the lack of independent confirmation; Times of Israel leads with the price jump and the Guards' claim.

overlap.reason: Brent was reported near $110 to $112 on the Hormuz disruption.
WTI settled at $103.66 Monday and rose further Tuesday.
Houthi claims of attacks on Saudi oil sites were also cited, unconfirmed by Riyadh.

headlines.story: Chip stocks rebound after eight-day losing streak
headlines.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 1.61% to end its longest losing run since 2010, and Kospi closed up 1.76% as institutions bought after seven straight losses.

coverage.title: Kospi rebounds sharply as institutions step in
Analysts Urge Caution on Chip Selloff as Foreign Outflows, Big Tech Earnings Loom

headlines.framing: Korean outlets stress institutional buying and caution before earnings; the US note stresses easing AI credit worries and weak breadth.

overlap.reason: Nvidia closed up 1.38% at $217.09 in the AI-chip rebound.

headlines.story: US 10-year yield rises to 5.14% ahead of Fed meeting
headlines.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.2 basis points to 5.14% on Monday, with investors expecting the Fed to hold at its Oct. 27-28 meeting and the NAHB housing index falling to 29.

overlap.reason: The 10-year yield is the series that rose.
Reports said higher yields weigh on the AI trade.

climate.headline: NOAA CPC: El Nino advisory, historic event possible
climate.detail: Sea surface anomalies exceed +4.0C in parts of the eastern Pacific; chance above 83% of a strong-to-very-strong event through Jan-Mar 2027. WMO notes Peru suspended anchoveta fishing and Hurricane Trudy was nearing Mexico on Oct 16.

climate.headline: EU gas storage 72.97% full, lowest for the date since 2011
climate.detail: Storage stood 15.11 points below the five-year average on Oct 6, against 82.9% a year earlier.

climate.headline: WMO: Horn of Africa northern rains failed, wetter Oct-Dec forecast
climate.detail: Ethiopia, South Sudan and Sudan had June-September deficits; equatorial and southern areas are forecast wetter than normal, raising flood risk in Ethiopia, Kenya and Somalia.

climate.headline: WMO: below-normal monsoon, mixed Oct-Dec rain outlook
climate.detail: Forecasts correctly predicted deficits in parts of India; crop effects are not yet known. Below-normal rain is likely in central and southern peninsular areas.

climate.headline: WMO: drought a major concern across much of Southeast Asia
climate.detail: El Nino risk is flagged for the region, with central and eastern Pacific sea temperatures forecast at record levels in Oct-Dec.
